The '''Gandolo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gandolo IV/Legends|Gandolo IV]].
